title: A small bakery website
replyTo: This is a sample, so there is no agent to send these to.

cards.question: Which title should the home page have?
cards.context: The home page of the bakery's site is titled Home, and that is all a browser tab shows.
cards.reason: A title that says what the page offers is easier to find among many open tabs.

cards.question: Reword the sign-up button?
cards.context: The newsletter form has a button that says Submit.
cards.reason: A button that says what happens next is clearer than a general word.

cards.question: Which format for the gallery photos?
cards.context: The gallery holds 40 photos, each about 2 MB, so the page loads slowly on a phone.
cards.reason: WebP files are much smaller and current browsers read them.

cards.question: Remove the autumn sale banner?
cards.context: The banner has run since October and the sale has ended.
cards.reason: An ended offer on the home page tells visitors the site is not looked after.

choices.label: Leave it up a little longer

cards.question: How should the menu be sorted?
cards.context: The menu page lists about 30 items in the order they were added.
cards.reason: People look for bread, then cakes, so grouping by type matches how they read.

cards.question: Add opening hours to the contact page?
cards.context: The contact page has an address and a phone number but no hours.
cards.reason: Opening hours are what most visitors come to the contact page to find.
